title: The 'Clarinet Gumbo' release and the planned Pelican Trio album
summary: His new album comes out in Europe and then the United States as 'Clarinet Gumbo'; another, with Barry Martyn and Duke Burrell recorded in Vienna, will be called the Pelican Trio after the Pelican State.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And then you have the 2 new record out now.

Yeah, I got a new one now that's coming out. It's out in France -- I mean, in Europe and now it's coming out here under a different title from what I gather from Pat. It's called -- what was the name of that thing, again, now?
What recording have you done in between '68 and now?
'68 and now? I got another one that's going to come out soon, soon as I finish making it. It's called the Pelican Trio.
Oh? Which will be -- whom -- you and who else?
But it was recorded originally in Vienna last year.
Vienna. And we're going to name it the Pelican Trio.
Why? Where does that name come from?
New Orleans. It's the Pelican state, --
